robustness.description: Nonparametric case bootstrap, 1000 replicates, set.seed(20261009) once; rows resampled with their WTS weights; same cfa() call; est.std of b1 and indirect1_econgriev; percentile 95% CI
robustness.note: estimate = bootstrap median of b1 est.std. Replicates attempted 1000, usable 1000, failed or non-converged 0 (excluded). Share of replicates with b1 < 0: 0.998. Indirect effect (T4): median -0.1405, 95% CI [-0.3054, -0.0435], CI excludes 0: True. Resample indices for all 1000 replicates were drawn in order right after the single set.seed call and stored, to make the run resumable.

bugs.description: Q15 (conservatism) code 8 is left in the data and used as a numeric value above 7 in every model, because the recode to NA is commented out. The script's own comment on that line gives the scale as 'Liberal 1 - 7 Conservative'. What code 8 means could not be determined: no public codebook or questionnaire for this 2021 survey was found (the OSF parent project only documents the 2020 wave, where Q15 is a different question). The authors' commented recodes elsewhere set analogous extra codes to NA (QF 6 'No answer', line 43-44; XQ14 4 and 5, lines 134-135, active).
bugs.evidence: outputs/data_facts.txt: Q15 takes values 1-8, with 64 rows = 8; 1203 - 64 = 1139 = paper's n. Published coefficients T1-T5 match only the run with code 8 kept; the published structural fit (chi2 516.954, robust CFI .911, TLI .892) matches only the run with code 8 set to NA (primary chi2.scaled 519.886, diagnostic 516.954; outputs/primary_vs_diagnostic.csv).

env_fixes: diffs/01_data_path.diff: script reads a non-public 117-column file (line 9); path changed to the public OSF extract Rural_Populism_Dataset.csv
diffs/02_raw_q24_absent.diff: RAW_Q24A-I columns absent from the public extract, mutate(across(all_of())) errored; lines 17, 19, 20, 22 commented out (variables never used later)
diffs/03_gt_library.diff: gt not installable (V8 needs system libv8, unavailable on Debian 13 arm64); library(gt) commented out (no gt function is called)
class_reason: All five headline standardized coefficients reproduce exactly to the paper's 3 decimals (and the paper's p values match the unstandardized z tests) from the deposited code with three environment fixes. Caveat on PROTOCOL section 7: the Dataverse deposit contains code only; the data come from the authors' OSF component (osf.io/mtd4z), which the paper does not cite, in a reduced 30-column extract under a different file name, so judged on the Dataverse deposit alone the materials are incomplete (class C); I propose A because the authors' own public materials reproduce the targets exactly, but flag this for the batch decision. The paper's structural-model fit statistics and n = 1,139 correspond to a different data state (Q15 code 8 as missing) than its coefficients.
confidence_reason: Targets matched by script with the pinned lavaan 0.6-19, but the data are an unlinked OSF extract and the paper's fit statistics and n come from a different data state than its coefficients; B not yet compared.
uncertainties: Data provenance: the CSV is linked to this paper only by the OSF component title, the byte-identical code file and matching variables; the paper does not cite it.
Meaning of Q15 code 8 (64 rows) could not be determined from any public codebook.

n: lavaan reports nobs = 1203 in both the primary and diagnostic runs (FIML keeps rows with missing Q15); the paper reports 1,139 = rows with Q15 != 8. How the authors obtained 1,139 is not determined.

Structural fit: primary run chi2.scaled 519.886, robust CFI 0.909, robust TLI 0.890 vs paper 516.954/.911/.892; the diagnostic run gives 516.954/0.911/0.892. SRMR and robust RMSEA agree in both. The paper's fit and coefficients thus come from two different data states.
Controls model (context): primary run gives chi2.scaled 779.793, df 201, n 998, equal to the paper's 779.793 / 201 / 998; the diagnostic run does not (794.407).

Table 1 reliability values (not targets) printed by the script (alpha, CR, AVE in outputs/full_script_output.txt) do not equal the paper's Table 1 values recorded in PREREG.md (e.g. paper alpha .856 and .891 for the last two factors); not investigated further because Table 1 is not a target.
Authors pinned no package versions; lavaan 0.6-19 / semTools 0.5-6 were chosen by the PREREG as contemporaneous with the 2024-11 deposit. Whether the authors used them is unknown.

Robustness R_a: the 1000 resample index vectors were drawn up front after set.seed(20261009) (same sequence as drawing inside the loop, given only sample() uses the RNG); a strict in-loop implementation would give the same draws unless lavaan consumes RNG, which was not checked.

Controls-model dummies code non-substantive answers as 0 (QF 6 'No answer' as not college, QB 12 as not over 65, QC 3/4 as not male); the script's comment at lines 118-119 states this choice. Affects the controls model only, not the targets; recorded as an observation, not a bug.
